description: Patient log extraction: companion extracts structured log data including a safety flag (stove incident) and nutrition concern from free-text caregiver report

conversation.content: Good morning. How did things go yesterday?
Not great. Mom left the stove on twice yesterday. I caught it both times, but it scared me. She also didn't eat much at dinner — just a few bites.
That's really frightening — stove incidents are exactly the kind of thing worth flagging, and I'm glad you caught it. Are you both okay? Did anything else happen?
We're okay. She slept fine through the night, no wandering. But the stove thing happening twice in one day has me worried.

That makes sense — twice in a day is a pattern worth paying attention to. I've logged this as a safety flag and I'll factor it in when we look at how things are going over time. Is she still recognizing you and knowing where she is?
Yes, she knew exactly who I was. Just — the stove thing.
